dimensions.assessment: Directly affects the Pit River Tribe and local federal land management agencies in California.
dimensions.evidence: takes approximately 603.94 acres of specified lands in California into trust for the benefit of the Pit River Tribe

dimensions.assessment: Locally significant for the tribe by expanding reservation land, but geographically limited.
dimensions.evidence: These combined lands, approximately 603.94 acres, shall be part of the tribe's reservation.

dimensions.assessment: Requires a land survey within 180 days, with minimal federal fiscal impact.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall carry out a complete survey of the Four Corners Federal land

dimensions.assessment: A localized land conveyance and administrative jurisdiction transfer between federal entities and a tribe.
dimensions.evidence: The Secretary of Agriculture shall transfer administrative jurisdiction over the Four Corners Federal land to the Secretary.

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change in land status and trust ownership.
dimensions.evidence: the Four Corners Federal land shall be taken into trust by the Secretary for the benefit of the Tribe

missing_information: Cost of conducting the required land survey
importance_detail.rationale: This bill transfers approximately 603.94 acres of land in California into trust for the Pit River Tribe and designates it as part of their reservation, while explicitly prohibiting gaming on the land.
